children.content:
# 🪟 Complete Windows Systems & PowerShell Administration Track

Welcome to your full Windows learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-windows-architecture` | **Kernel & NT Architecture** | Windows NT Kernel (User vs Kernel mode), Executive Services, HAL, `$PSVersionTable` |
| `01-powershell-cmdlets-and-pipeline`| **PowerShell Object Pipeline** | Verb-Noun cmdlets, object pipeline vs text streaming, `Get-Member`, `Where-Object` |
| `02-filesystem-and-psdrives` | **PSDrives & Filesystem** | `%SystemRoot%`, `%AppData%`, PSDrives (`HKLM:`, `Cert:`, `Env:`), `Get-ChildItem` |
| `03-registry-internals-and-management` | **Windows Registry** | Hives (`HKLM`, `HKCU`), `Get-ItemProperty`, `Set-ItemProperty`, `reg.exe` |
| `04-process-and-service-management` | **Processes & Services** | `Get-Process`, `Stop-Process`, Windows Services (`Get-Service`, `sc.exe`) |
| `05-windows-event-logs-and-auditing`| **Event Logs & Auditing** | Event Viewer channels (Security, System), `Get-WinEvent`, XPath queries, Event IDs |
| `06-user-and-group-management` | **Users & SIDs** | Local accounts vs Domain accounts, SIDs, UAC, `Get-LocalUser`, `New-LocalUser` |
| `07-ntfs-permissions-and-icacls` | **NTFS ACLs & Security** | DACLs, NTFS inheritance, `Get-Acl`, `Set-Acl`, `icacls.exe`, Alternate Data Streams |
| `08-windows-networking-and-firewall`| **Networking & Firewall** | `Get-NetIPAddress`, `Test-NetConnection`, `Get-NetTCPConnection`, Windows Firewall rules |
| `09-scheduled-tasks-and-cim-wmi` | **Tasks & CIM/WMI** | Windows Task Scheduler (`Register-ScheduledTask`), `Get-CimInstance` hardware queries |
| `10-package-management-winget` | **Package Management** | `winget` CLI, Chocolatey, Scoop, PowerShell Gallery modules |
| `11-wsl2-architecture-and-usage` | **WSL2 Architecture** | WSL2 lightweight Hyper-V VM, `/mnt/c/` filesystem interop, `wsl --install` |
| `12-remote-management-winrm` | **WinRM & PSRemoting** | `Enable-PSRemoting`, `Enter-PSSession`, `Invoke-Command`, JEA security |
| `13-hyper-v-and-windows-sandbox` | **Virtualization** | Type-1 Hypervisor, Windows Sandbox, Virtual Switches (External/Internal) |
| `14-powershell-scripting-automation`| **Advanced Scripting** | `[CmdletBinding()]`, parameter validation, `try`/`catch`, `$ErrorActionPreference` |
| `15-sysinternals-and-diagnostics` | **Sysinternals Suite** | Process Explorer, ProcMon, Sysmon, Autoruns, live kernel diagnostics |
| `16-active-directory-and-gpo` | **Active Directory & GPO**| Domain Controllers, OUs, Group Policy Objects (`gpupdate /force`, `gpresult /r`) |
| `17-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 Windows SysAdmin & DevOps interview questions & troubleshooting drills |

---

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 00 - Windows NT Architecture & PowerShell 🛠️

### Windows Architecture Layers:
- **User Mode**: Subsystems (Win32, POSIX, WSL), user applications, service processes.
- **Kernel Mode**: Executive Services (Object Manager, Process/Thread Manager, Memory Manager), Kernel, Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL), device drivers.

children.name: pipeline_demo.ps1
children.content:
# Objects flowing through pipeline (not plain text strings)
Get-Process | Where-Object WorkingSet64 -gt 100MB | Select-Object Name, Id, @{Name='RAM(MB)'; Expression={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64 / 1MB, 2)}} | Sort-Object 'RAM(MB)' -Descending | Select-Object -First 5

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 01 - PowerShell Object Pipeline

Unlike Linux Bash (which passes text streams), PowerShell passes **structured .NET objects** down the pipeline `|`, enabling type-safe property inspection with `Get-Member`.

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 02 - PSDrives & Navigation

PowerShell treats filesystems, environment variables, certificates, and the registry uniformly as **PSDrives**:
```powershell
Get-PSDrive
Set-Location HKLM:\Software
Set-Location Env:
Set-Location Cert:\LocalMachine
```

children.name: registry.ps1
children.content:
# Query Windows CurrentVersion info from registry
Get-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion" -Name ProductName, CurrentBuildNumber

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 03 - Windows Registry Architecture

- `HKLM (HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE)`: System-wide settings.
- `HKCU (HKEY_CURRENT_USER)`: Logged-in user profile preferences.

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 05 - Windows Event Logs & Security Auditing

### Essential Security Event IDs:
- **`4624`**: Successful logon.
- **`4625`**: Failed logon (Brute-force indicator).
- **`4672`**: Special privileges assigned to new logon.
- **`7036`**: Service entered a stopped or started state.

# 06 - Users, Groups & Security Identifiers (SIDs)

```powershell
# List local administrators group members
Get-LocalGroupMember -Group "Administrators"
```

children.name: README.md

# 07 - NTFS File Permissions & icacls

```powershell
# View access control list of a directory
Get-Acl -Path C:\Windows | Format-List

# Grant Full Control to a user with icacls
icacls "C:\Data" /grant:r "DomainUsers:(OI)(CI)F" /T
```

# 11 - Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL2)

WSL2 runs a genuine Linux kernel inside a lightweight utility VM on top of Hyper-V technology with full dynamic memory allocation.

```powershell
wsl --list --verbose
wsl --set-default-version 2
```

```powershell
}
```

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 17 - High-Yield Windows & PowerShell Interview Questions 🎯

### Top 5 Interview Questions:
1. **Object Pipeline vs Text Stream**: PowerShell passes strongly-typed .NET objects rather than unstructured raw byte/text strings.
2. **NTFS Permissions vs Share Permissions**: Most restrictive permission applies when accessing files over the network.
3. **WinRM (5985/5986)**: Standard remote management protocol for PowerShell remoting.
4. **WSL2 vs WSL1**: WSL1 translates system calls on Windows NT kernel; WSL2 runs a real Linux kernel in a lightweight Hyper-V container.
5. **Event ID 4625**: Crucial for tracking failed authentication attempts and brute-force attacks in SIEM environments.
